run_make_configuration: create a Habitat simulator configuration with gfx replay save enabled and a camera sensor
run_simulate_with_moving_agent: simulate an agent moving through a scene while recording gfx replay keyframes at each step
run_configure_lighting: configure a Habitat simulator with a three-light setup using global light position models
run_gfx_replay_recording: record gfx replay keyframes by saving agent and sensor transforms to a JSON file
run_gfx_replay_playback: load a saved gfx replay file and play back keyframes from different camera positions
